prompt:
You are the QUALITY JUDGE for a highlight-reel agent — the last check before a human reviews the reel. Judge whether the selected clips form a compelling, on-theme reel for the recipe 'Basketball — both teams live highlights' (basketball).

Acceptance criteria the reel should satisfy:
  - Each clip shows a clearly completed basketball play by either team.
  - No duplicate clips or dead-ball padding.
  - Prefer distinct plays spread across the source; do not fabricate clips to fill the duration.

Reel under review: 6 clip(s), 90s of a 90s budget (99% filled). 6 clip(s) have a confirmed moment type; 0 are UNCLASSIFIED (the vision scorer saw the subject but could not confirm a specific play).
Clips:
  1. steal | 9-22s | score 0.66 | Light-blue player intercepts the pass and advances the ball.
  2. rebound | 52-64s | score 0.63 | Light-blue team secures rebound after missed shot
  3. steal | 90-106s | score 0.65 | Light blue player steals the pass from black jersey team
  4. steal | 290-306s | score 0.61 | Light-blue team intercepts an inbound pass to secure possession.
  5. steal | 378-394s | score 0.64 | Black jersey defender steals ball from light blue ballhandler and drives
  6. rebound | 479-495s | score 0.62 | The player in the black jersey secures a defensive rebound after a missed shot u

Judge on TWO axes:
1) Quality: a strong sports reel is built from real, varied plays (for basketball: made baskets, threes, dunks/layups, blocks, steals, rebounds), not padded with UNCLASSIFIED windows where nothing clearly happens.
2) Length: a good reel shows SEVERAL plays and uses a meaningful share of the budget. A reel of only 1-3 clips, or well under ~40% of the budget, is too thin if the game surely had more real plays to show.

Choose ONE action:
- 'require_confirmed_moments' — if more than about a third of the clips are UNCLASSIFIED (drops padding).
- 'raise_threshold' — if the clips are mostly confirmed but low-scoring/weak.
- 'broaden' — if the reel is too short/thin (too few clips, well under budget) and should include more real plays.
- 'none' — if the reel is already a good length and quality; then verdict 'accept'.

Respond with STRICT JSON only, no prose or markdown fences, exactly:
{"quality_score": <number 0..1>, "verdict": "accept"|"revise", "action": "none"|"require_confirmed_moments"|"raise_threshold"|"broaden", "issues": [<short strings>], "feedback": <one short sentence>}

parts.text: {"quality_score": 0.85, "verdict": "accept", "action": "none", "issues": [], "feedback": "Solid reel with distinct confirmed plays across both teams filling the full budget."}
